propositions: The rebar-implement skill dispatches a subagent in Phase 4d without specifying a model tier, causing it to inherit the expensive orchestrator model instead of a cheaper tier.
The skill lacks guidance on which work is safe to delegate to cheaper models and how to escalate when a cheaper implementer is insufficient.
A Model tiering section with capability-tier definitions and cross-harness example mappings (Claude Code and Codex CLI) must be added to enable proper cost-aware delegation.
Phase 4d must specify standard-tier as default, restrict cheap-tier to transcription-only work, and require constraint documentation.
A new Phase 4e-bis escalation ladder must distinguish normal held-out iteration from model-weakness escalation triggers while preserving the held-out-TDD invariant.
